name: skill-builder
description: Create, audit, and explain portable agent skills using a preserved knowledge base and offline Python helpers.

interface.longDescription: Create a portable agent skill, audit an existing skill repository, or explain skill-building practices using the complete preserved knowledge base. Named create and audit modes guide task contracts, instruction design, resources, host adapters, tests, evaluation, and release decisions. Offline Python helpers retrieve original sources, prepare project scaffolds, and collect static audit evidence. Agent judgment completes creation and semantic review; structural checks do not certify safety, usefulness, or publication readiness. The package requires local file access and Python 3.10 or newer for its helpers. Optional YAML and schema validators are provisioned separately. No hosted backend, MCP server, automatic installer, telemetry, or publisher-paid service is included. Codex is the primary target; other adapters and historical trials retain their documented evidence limits. Stable versioning does not establish comprehensive host compatibility or OpenAI directory approval.
defaultPrompt: Create a portable skill that turns bug reports into QA test plans.
